_meta.description: AICTE Approval Process Handbook clause references for validation rules
_meta.disclaimer: These are REPRESENTATIVE EXCERPTS created for SIH26261 demo purposes. They are inspired by AICTE guidelines but are NOT verbatim copies of the official handbook. For actual regulatory requirements, refer to the official AICTE Approval Process Handbook.

R1.clause_text: Every institution seeking approval for engineering programs shall possess a minimum land area of 2.5 acres (1.0 hectare) with clear title in the name of the applying trust/society. For institutions located in metropolitan cities with population exceeding 25 lakh, the minimum requirement may be relaxed to 1.5 acres subject to approval of multi-storey construction by the competent municipal authority. The land must be free from all encumbrances and must not be agricultural land unless conversion certificate has been obtained.

R2.clause_text: The applicant trust/society/company must be registered under the Indian Trusts Act 1882, or the Societies Registration Act 1860, or Section 8 of the Companies Act 2013, as applicable. The registration must be verifiable through the official state registry. The trust/society must have education or educational activities listed as one of its primary objectives in the registration deed.

R3.clause_text: The institution shall maintain a minimum faculty-to-student ratio of 1:20 across all approved programs. For programs in emerging technology areas (AI/ML, Data Science, Cyber Security), the ratio shall be 1:15. The ratio is calculated based on the total sanctioned intake across all programs and the total number of regular, full-time faculty members. Visiting faculty and adjunct faculty shall not be counted for this computation.

R4.clause_text: Faculty members teaching in engineering programs must hold a minimum qualification of M.Tech/M.E. or equivalent postgraduate degree in the relevant discipline from a recognized university. Preference shall be given to candidates with doctoral degrees. Faculty members with only undergraduate qualifications (B.Tech/B.E.) are not eligible for regular teaching positions. However, industry practitioners with minimum 10 years of experience may be appointed as adjunct faculty subject to approval by the affiliating university.

R5.clause_text: All documents submitted as part of the application shall be verified for authenticity and integrity. The Council reserves the right to employ digital forensic tools to detect tampering, forgery, or manipulation of submitted documents. Any document found to have been tampered with shall result in immediate rejection of the application, and the applicant may be debarred from applying for a period of up to 3 years. Documents must retain original metadata and must not show signs of digital manipulation.

R6.clause_text: The applicant must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the State Government or Union Territory Administration before submitting the application. The NOC must be valid for the academic year of application and must not have expired at the time of submission. The NOC must be issued by a recognized authority including the State Government, Directorate of Technical Education, or State Technical Education Board. NOCs from unauthorized bodies shall not be accepted.

R7.clause_text: The applying trust/society must have been registered at least one year prior to the date of application submission. Newly formed trusts or societies that do not meet this criterion shall not be eligible to apply. This requirement ensures that the governing body has sufficient organizational maturity and operational history to undertake the responsibility of running a technical institution.

R8.clause_text: The institution must have a minimum built-up carpet area as prescribed based on the sanctioned intake. For an intake of 60 students per program, the minimum carpet area shall be 5000 sq ft, inclusive of classrooms, laboratories, library, and administrative areas. The built-up area must be certified by a registered architect and must comply with applicable building codes and accessibility standards. Temporary or pre-fabricated structures shall not be counted towards the carpet area requirement.

R9.clause_text: The application submission date recorded in the system must accurately reflect the actual date of submission. Applications bearing future dates shall be treated as invalid and will be automatically rejected by the portal. The submission timestamp is recorded by the AICTE web portal and cannot be overridden manually. Any discrepancy in dates shall be flagged for manual review.

R10.clause_text: The following documents are mandatory for submission with every new institution application: (a) Trust/Society Registration Certificate, (b) Land ownership documents with title deed, (c) NOC from State Government, (d) Building plan approval from competent authority, (e) Faculty list with qualification certificates, (f) Affidavit on prescribed format, (g) Audited financial statements for the last 3 years, (h) Fire safety certificate from the local fire department. Applications missing any mandatory document shall not be processed and will be returned for completion.
